findings: (1) Scope holds. Running git diff --name-only 0cdca01...3b03696 lists 14 files, all inside the owned set: review/* (index.html, style.css, practice_s2.js, practice_s2_bundle.py, practice_s2_routes.py, make_practice_fixture_s2.py, browser_smoke_s2.py/.mjs, practice_s2_review_server.diff), tests/test_review_ui_s2.py, docs/spec/sprints/REVIEW_UI_S2.md and docs/agent-notes/sprints/20261006-s2/ui_core-*.json. No root-owned or foreign file is touched. None of the 14 files overlaps the 16 files main changed in 0cdca01..ef31930.

(4) Reran tests in the worktree with nix FFMPEG/FFPROBE: 'Ran 35 tests in 24.4s / OK', 35 'ok', 0 skipped, 0 failures. Matches the claimed 35/35 (22 S2 + 13 S1). The tests are substantive. A Node vm harness runs the shipped practice_s2.js against a fake DOM and checks: no .play() call sites, preload=none, a blind mapping that stays hidden until reveal with only a GET request, uncertain joins with aria 'uncertain join' and '?' glyphs, toggles that default to unchecked, an abstained row showing '—' and never 0.0 ms, and no verdict words. Quick-marks tests round-trip 12 marks through the real annotation_v2 store and phrase_anchor. Composer tests cover refusals for hash/source/extent mismatch.

(2) No writes to protected locations were found. The 5 protected hashes in the handoff match today: manifest 61c9b393…, cleaned 9ed50aec…, denoised 26c9f42c…, source d68e4968…, flags 95a0106c…. A find over artifacts/runs for files newer than the lane composer returned nothing. Lane outputs live in artifacts/s2/ui_core/ and test-tmp, which .gitignore:3 /artifacts/ covers. practice_s2_bundle.py:151-162 refuses output_inside_runs and output_outside_artifacts after resolve(). The composer makes no downloads and starts no daemon. browser_smoke_s2.py terminates and then kills the Chrome it owns.

(5) Doctrine holds. No highpass, notch, bandreject or 80 Hz appears in any S2 file. The only FFmpeg filter is atrim plus volume, with SUBPROCESS_TIMEOUT 120 s. The bundle carries 21 unknown fields. Adoption block is all false.

(6) Repair verified: phrase_timing schema 2 now accepted (direction, direction_status, direction_basis); schema 1 refused as layer_schema_superseded; measured rows on real takes have withheld_uncalibrated with null direction; synthetic fixtures have synthetic_known_offset_fixture with valid direction; abstained rows have no direction fields. Real-take rendering updated: 56 measured rows now show 'direction withheld (uncalibrated)' instead of timing labels. Tests added for schema 2 direction policy (8 cases). Loudness, triage, media, protected hashes verified unchanged.

(3) Claim classes correct. Metrics are labelled by source: measured (direct, copied from prior runs), inferred (timeline equivalence, no-stretch flags), unknown (operator-labelled). No note-correctness or missed-note verdict appears. adoption fields all false.

Not independently verified: the headless-Chrome walkthrough counts (viewport 4/4, real 56/56 checks, 117 nodes). I did not rerun browser_smoke_s2. These rest on ui_core-walkthrough.json and repair-phase4.json.
The lane commits 33867e6 and 8e8f957 are unsigned, and the repair commit 3b03696 is unsigned (--no-gpg-sign). Root must sign the merge.
